title: A side alternating check and chase commits neither violation
rationale: Red's chariot checks the black king from d4 on one move of each cycle and renews its attack on the unprotected black cannon on a5 from a4 on the other, so the check flags across the nine plies are f T f f f T f f f and Red alternates the two violation classes. Each accepted class is a single behaviour that must be sustained by every move the side makes across the counted occurrences; neither is, so Red commits neither and the repetition is neutral and merely claimable at the third occurrence. The engine implements no combined check-and-chase rule, so its agreement here is the absence of an implementation rather than evidence; the authority is the accepted interpretation in docs/xiangqi-rules.md.
